name: Digital Sports Watch with Rubber Strap
description: A digital sports watch with a square-octagon case and a rubber strap. The dial is printed water resist 30 m (3 bar): that covers splashes and rain, not swimming or diving.

specs.label: Water resistance
specs.value: Printed on the dial: 30 m (3 bar); splashes and rain only

specs.label: Colours
specs.value: Army Green, Lime Green, Black, Red, Navy Blue

source.notes: Supplier Bantian Dongxi Nanbei Department Store Wholesaler (Longgang). Screenshot price CNY 7 (about N1,552.85 on the page, rate 221.84), from 1 item, 8K+ sold, 20+ praised, repurchase rate 30% (at the flag threshold, not over), Choice badge. Title: Watch male student electronic watch large male junior high school student boy multi-functional 30m waterproof watch; the 'student', 'boy' and 'waterproof' wording is left out of the copy. The screenshot shows ONE price, CNY 7; per-colour prices and the Style tab were not shown, so whether all five colours cost CNY 7 is not confirmed. Weight 47 g is the owner's figure (shipping.weight_kg 0.047). Strap material 'rubber' is the owner's description; the case/strap material, battery type, size and strap length are not stated, so none are claimed. TRADEMARK/LOOK-ALIKE: every dial prints a look-alike maker mark (C-SHCOK style text) and a second line (GASJQ), and the design imitates a well-known shock-resistant watch. No photo hides or avoids it (all five show it; it is on the product). Neither mark is in the name, copy or tags; no shock-resistance claim. Dial also prints WATER 30M RESIST and WR3BAR: copy says water resist 30 m (3 bar) printed on the dial, for splashes not diving. Photos: supplier backgrounds were fake (Christmas, party, beach, Chinese-text scenes), so each watch is cut out on the store background. Sources: army green from img7 (Chinese overlay text sits on the background, removed by the cutout), lime green img3, black img4, red img8 (img9 is a duplicate, unused), navy img5 (800 px original, upscaled 2x, soft), Grey blue was dropped by the owner on 4 Nov 2026 (it only existed in the 769 px group shot). Army green and navy photos redone 4 Nov 2026 with hand-drawn cut lines (railing strip and glare wedge removed); navy is still soft (800 px source enlarged 2.2x). Button cell inside (per the owner): ships_by_air left unset, as for the other watches on the store.
